target_questions.question: Can a small-droplet fraction stabilize a two-phase rotating detonation otherwise limited by larger-droplet evaporation?
target_questions.target_basis: Tier 1 D009 provides the evaporation-length stability anchor; this paper directly tests bidisperse distributions.

evidence_candidates.claim_text: The simulations show complete refill-zone vaporization for very small droplets, destabilization/extinction as larger droplets persist and block replenishment, and stabilization when a small-droplet fraction is present in bidisperse sprays.
evidence_candidates.evidence_summary: Monodisperse and bidisperse n-heptane cases connect size distribution to refill-zone equivalence ratio, fuel fraction, wave speed, and extinction.

core_links.shared_parameter_or_mechanism: evaporation completeness and unburned pockets govern wave stability

limitations: Two-dimensional Eulerian-Lagrangian model without fuel prevaporization; size thresholds are configuration-specific.
visual_verification: Targeted visual verification performed where numeric/glyph-dependent abstract claims required it; no figure digitization.
